item.skt: utsuSh+ma dzam+b+ha la sA d+ha naM nA Ma
item.coloph: paN+Di ta a b+ha ka ra gup+tas mdzad pa'i u tsash+ma dza b+ha la sgrub pa'i thabs rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po paN+Di ta a lang ka de ba dang / lo tsA ba shAkya'i dge slong tshul khrims 'byung gnas sbas pas/ chos 'khor shongs ma'i gtsug lag khang du bsgyur te gtan la phab pa'o/ slad kyis paN+Di ta ma hA bi b+hu ti tsan+d+ra dang / chag lo tsA ba dge slong chos rje dpal gyis bsgyur cing dag par bgyis so
